purpose: No-long-training repair for G6.1 full-cycle failure. Validate and apply a deterministic D15-P4D code-equivalent inventory layer for P4D/GEO/random_walk branch targets.
notes: G6.1 failed mainly on P4D/GEO theta_c inventory bias, not on phie. This package does not start another long training run.
Step A checks whether the D15-P4D deterministic current-integral generator rule reproduces P4D soft-label targets on the known failing profiles.
Step B evaluates the G6.1 checkpoint with P4D branch theta/cs/phie/phis predictions replaced by deterministic D15-P4D generator-equivalent outputs computed from observed t/I/V and prior JSON.
